items.claim: GOV.UK styles explicitly warn teams not to assign new meanings to colors or alter core button and form-border treatments when applying the system manually.
The system provides reusable accessible components for forms, navigation, panels, tables, and common service interactions.
The design system pairs styles and components with patterns for common tasks rather than treating page styling as sufficient service design.
Its distinctive quality comes from predictable service behavior and content hierarchy more than ornamental visual novelty.
